annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2010/26/EU of 31 March 2010 amending Directive 97/68/EC on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2010/26/EU of 31 March 2010 amending Directive 97/68/EC on measures against the emission of gaseous and particulate pollutants from internal combustion engines to be installed in non-road mobile machinery
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union L 86/29
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive amending Directive 97/68/EC on emissions from engines in non-road mobile machinery. It adds stage IIIB/IV type-approval requirements for electronically controlled engines, updates test cycles (cold/hot start NRTC), extends a derogation for hand-held machinery to 2013, and simplifies flexibility-scheme reporting. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Extends derogation for SH:2/SH:3 hand-held hedge trimmers and chainsaws to 31 July 2013
Adds Annex I section 8 type-approval rules for stage IIIB/IV electronically controlled engines, prohibiting defeat strategies
Requires NOx control and reagent monitoring, operator warnings and instructions
Introduces cold/hot start NRTC composite test (10%/90% weighting)
Member States must transpose by 31 March 2011
